subject.title: Dashboard: A2UI action-bridge capability — run canvas apps as dashboard widgets

question: Should the A2UI dashboard bridge wait for the browser Canvas action-ingress contract in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/68497, or should dashboard define its own trusted-parent action route now?
rationale: The implementation choice changes a security boundary and could create competing web A2UI action paths; source inspection shows neither the dashboard host nor the web action sink exists on current main.

options.title: Sequence through Canvas ingress first
options.body: Keep this issue open, resolve the browser Canvas action sink first, and implement the dashboard adapter against that single approved contract.

options.title: Sponsor dashboard bridge now
options.body: Approve a dashboard-owned action route now, accepting a larger security review and possible later consolidation with Canvas ingress.

options.title: Defer outside core
options.body: If bundled dashboard widgets are not a core direction, move this to an external plugin or ClawHub package after any missing plugin APIs are defined.

recommendation.title: Sequence through Canvas ingress first
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open, resolve the browser Canvas action sink first, and implement the dashboard adapter against that single approved contract.

likelyOwner.reason: He has the strongest related product-direction signal from the merged plugin-tab seam and maintainer-labeled inline-widget work, while the remaining decision is product/security sequencing rather than a narrow code ownership question.
